purpose: Supplement reviewer-requested temporal aggregation and measurement-definition analyses using retrieved source records

whu.population: Original WHU cancer cohort; one earliest source-linked admission per patient with an unambiguous native encounter and admission/discharge clocks matching processed stay days
whu.outcome: Unchanged original patient-level recorded-MACE label; not a same-stay incident-event endpoint
whu.window_rule: Only reports linked to the selected native encounter, at or after its admission and no later than min(cutoff, discharge). Admission-only is a zero-hour measurement cap; no claim that all prior-history information is absent.
whu.primary_clock: Outer report datetime; omit reports whose inner date disagrees with the outer calendar date
clock_sensitivities: retain discrepant inner dates using outer report datetime
date-only end-of-day inclusion, avoiding invented midnight availability
whu.aggregation: Median of deduplicated accepted numeric measurements within each cap
whu.assay_rules: Reuse exact names, literal units and report-context rules of the completed four-laboratory transfer analysis
whu.assay_sensitivity: All linked patients, all source records: exact-name numeric aggregation versus documented-unit/context aggregation. This is a new permissive-mapping comparison, not a reconstruction of the original 104-input model.
whu.validation: Five patient-stratified folds with fixed seed 42; same folds for all measurement caps. Training-side median imputation; logistic scaling within train; ensemble round selection within outer training only.
models: 50:50 XGBoost/random-forest ensemble using existing four-laboratory protocol
whu.uncertainty: 2000 patient bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF predictions, seed 20261103; paired comparisons share draws. Excludes refitting uncertainty.

sch.population: Original SCH patients and stay-day keys; raw 2021-2025 seven-slot diagnosis exports
sch.analysis: Deduplicate identical clinical rows, combine matched same-stay diagnosis slots, tabulate component/role/POA and current-patient overlap. Separate MI/stroke, cardiac arrest, heart failure diagnosis and history codes.
sch.interpretation: Recorded-diagnosis composition and present-on-admission sensitivity; no manufactured onset time, no new first-MACE model
sch.old_staging_exports: Previously unlinked older binary tables cannot supply current-stay adjustment covariates
sch.four_lab_transfer: Not estimable without source-linked SCH unit/specimen definitions; original numeric values alone do not establish comparability

post_hoc_candidate_analysis.rule: Require both MI/stroke code and compatible name without explicit historical or uncertain qualifier; POA absent only within a matched stay
post_hoc_candidate_analysis.reconciliation: Seven candidates had negative original labels; targeted source-locator index prepared, no clinical relabeling performed
post_hoc_candidate_analysis.conditional_scenario: Retain original SCH OOF scores and hypothetically assign the seven candidates positive labels; 2000 paired patient bootstrap draws; not an overall label validation estimate

primary_manuscript_results: Retained; all outputs stored in this new directory
